name: stacked_waves
description: 0.9.0's stacked waves (release page: the hero and Call the next wave): High Water on Wickhollow at Normal, me the Lamplighter played by the plan bot, Ana a Lookout the caretaker plays, as the README's shot. In wave 7 (Gourdlings and Scuttlers), while it still sends its own, the horn's tooltip offers wave 8 and what it pays; then the clip, the camera over the Welling: D once ('Call wave 8 now? Press again'), D again, the banner 'Wave 8 called early · +27 gold', and wave 8's Thornbacks and Duskmoths set out among wave 7's creeps, the strip saying 'Waves 7–8/12'. The waves to come start at wave 7, both marked now. Then wave 9 is called too, and the hero is three waves on the road along the pond once wave 9 has nearly all set out, no life lost.

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([7]) and Game.can_stack() and Game.lives == 20
steps.msg: wave 7 alone on the road and still sending, no life lost, and a call would be taken

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipBody').text.begins_with('Call wave 8 now: +15 for the window')
steps.msg: the horn offers wave 8 and what it pays

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 8 now? Press again' and Game.wave == 7

steps.msg: the second press called wave 8 onto the road
the waves to come start at wave 7
three waves on the road, no life lost yet
